title: 保存先と二つの稼働先を見比べる探検猫
usage: secret-rotationの導入と回遊画像。概念的な場面、技術仕様の証明ではない。
prompt: Create a new editorial illustration for AI Security Playbook. Reference image is STYLE AND CHARACTER reference only, not edit target. Preserve this black explorer cat with tapered muzzle, natural expressive eyes, engraved ink fur and orange backpack. Wide 3:2 composition, warm ivory paper, fine black pen hatching with restrained orange accent, no text/letters/digits, no green, no brain. Mountains lightly in background, substantial breathing space, same mature charming ink storybook field-notes style.
